# Theme 5: Tree-Based Algorithms {.unnumbered}

Decision trees, and models that combine many of them, are among the strongest models for tabular data. In this theme you see how a single tree learns, and how random forests and gradient boosting combine many trees into a better model.

## Activities

Work through the activities in order:

1. [Decision Trees](009_decision_trees.ipynb): a decision tree by hand and with scikit-learn, how a tree learns, overfitting, hyperparameters, and regression trees.
2. [Random Forests](010_random_forests.ipynb): many trees trained on random parts of the data, their hyperparameters, voting and extra-trees.
3. [Gradient Boosting](011_gradient_boosting.ipynb): trees that each correct the errors of the previous ones, their hyperparameters, XGBoost and LightGBM, AdaBoost and stacking.

In [Theme 6](theme-6.qmd), the last theme, you learn to communicate your work and to use machine-learning research.
